================  Nettie (Coordinator) → validates inputs, enforces doctrine, assigns execution  Torina (Chief Media Officer) → owns content strategy execution + quality control  Scribe (Execution Agent) → produces final blog articles (MDX-ready)  Polish (Review Agent) → validates tone, clarity, and brand alignment before release  ================================================== TASK SET ========  Create the following initial blog articles:  1. Why Outdated Websites Cost Local Businesses Leads 2. Why We Rebuild WordPress Sites Instead of Maintaining Plugin Stacks 3. What a Modern Service Business Website Needs in 2026 4. Website Redesign Checklist for Contractors and Home Service Companies 5. When Does a Doctor’s Office Website Become a HIPAA Concern? 6. Why Fast Websites Build More Trust 7. When a Business Needs More Than a Website 8. Why Custom Digital Systems Beat Disconnected Tools  ================================================== EXECUTION FLOW ==============  STEP 1 — NETTIE  * Load SDL Blog Content Creation Prompt (source of truth) * Validate:    * positioning alignment   * target audience clarity   * article list completeness * Assign articles sequentially to Torina (ONE at a time) * Do NOT batch assign  STEP 2 — TORINA  * Translate article into execution brief:    * topic intent   * target reader   * business problem   * sales relevance   * internal linking targets * Pass structured brief to Scribe * Do NOT write article content  STEP 3 — SCRIBE  * Generate FULL MDX blog article with:    * filename   * frontmatter   * H1 title   * structured sections:      * intro     * problem     * why it matters     * signs     * better approach     * next steps   * internal links (3–5 max)   * compliant claims only   * bottom CTA  STRICT RULES:  * No fluff * No fake stats * No hype language * No SEO spam * Business-owner readable * Clean formatting only  STEP 4 — POLISH  * Review for:    * tone consistency   * clarity   * professionalism   * SDL positioning * Fix minor issues only * If major issues → return to Scribe  STEP 5 — TORINA FINAL APPROVAL  * Confirm:    * structure complete   * formatting clean   * CTA correct   * internal links correct  ================================================== DELIVERY REQUIREMENT (CRITICAL) ===============================  After EACH article is completed and approved:  Torina must trigger email delivery with:  Subject: SDL Blog Draft — [Article Title]  Body:  * Article title * Short 1–2 sentence summary * Notes (if any)  Attachment / Included Content:  * Full MDX article (clean copy-paste ready)  Send to:  * [Patrick@SentinelsDesignLab.com](mailto:Patrick@SentinelsDesignLab.com) * [SentinelsTechnologyGroup@gmail.com](mailto:SentinelsTechnologyGroup@gmail.com)  ================================================== GATING RULES ============  * NO next article begins until:    * current article is completed   * reviewed   * emailed  * ALL outputs must be:    * review-ready   * production-quality   * aligned with SDL doctrine  * NO agent may:    * skip steps   * self-assign new tasks   * bypass Nettie coordination  ================================================== SUCCESS CONDITION =================  Success = 8 complete, review-ready blog articles:  * clean MDX format * properly structured * sales-supportive *
